column1: # Marvel Rivals team-ups after the Season 9 rework (hero and partner pairings as of Season 10.5, Oct 2026).
# Every hero has two team-ups and equips one. The enhanced version switches on when the partner
# hero is on the same team; the scoreboard box is full color when it is, shaded when it isn't.
# Effects (what a team-up does, its numbers) are deliberately NOT stored: balance patches change
# them every season, so they would go stale. Only the pairings are kept. Deadpool is listed once
# as "Deadpool" and applies to all three of his roles.
# Source: rivalsdex.com/team-ups (Season 10.5), cross-checked with expcarry.com's team-ups guide.
